package rulefixtures

import (
	"database/sql"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for sql_rows_scan_logic_outside_repository: Code outside repositories that manually scans rows into structs.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

type Invoice struct {
	ID     int
	Amount float64
	Status string
}

func ListInvoicesHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, db *sql.DB) {
	rows, err := db.QueryContext(r.Context(), "SELECT id, amount, status FROM invoices")
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "query failed", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	var invoices []Invoice
	for rows.Next() {
		var inv Invoice
		if err := rows.Scan(&inv.ID, &inv.Amount, &inv.Status); err != nil {
			http.Error(w, "scan failed", http.StatusInternalServerError)
			return
		}
		invoices = append(invoices, inv)
	}
	fmt.Fprintf(w, `{"count":%d}`, len(invoices))
}
